claim_limit: P/F/SEA design-field exposure of raster terrain triangles; does not query compiled ODOL clipping or prove rendered visibility/artistic defect. Primary categories are diagnostic; layer flags overlap. The 1e-4m value only labels near-contact.

sea_source.scope: SEA levels come from the pinned native snapshot. SEA is applied as a continuous face only when all three triangle vertices have cls==1; cls==1 sea-mask derivation is anchored to build_v30_water.py:293-314. Mixed ocean-class triangles are not treated as fully covered.

method.residual_selector: EV87.edge_angles(EV95 heights promoted float32→float64), strict angle>30.0°; exact residual count reconciles the pinned census report.
method.families: diag, vertical, horizontal with exact two native NW-SE terrain triangles per hinge; P is its cell float64 scalar, F is the actual three per-corner float64 samples for that triangle; no averaging across cells/faces.
method.triangle_rule: signed clearance = water_level - H at its three actual raster vertices; affine field means all three positive => fully below that sheet; mixed signs => edge crossing; negative => an emerged vertex. Exact zero is contact.
method.masks: ANY of exact 4 hinge vertices. dry/bank/interior use EV87._ev87_populations; wet_support is EV79 constraints; civil_guard is union of EV79 other_fixed, engineering_halo, narva, B reserve/platform, and road reference corridor.
method.water_width_proxy: distance transform to nearest cell without finite P or any finite F, sampled at adjacent triangle cells; approximate cell-center radius only, not source river polygon width.
method.not_loaded: compiled ODOL face index; this is a design-field/terrain comparison, not native mesh intersection. A water-class boundary is not itself proof of an actual rendered shoreline.
